title: Daily Dividend Report: AAPL, COF, EL, COL, CBS
text:
Daily Dividend Report: AAPL, COF, EL, COL, CBS 
Apple has declared a cash dividend of $0.63 per share of the Company's common stock. 
The dividend is payable on February 15, 2018 to shareholders of record as of the close of business on February 12, 2018. 
Capital One Financial Corporation (COF) announced a quarterly dividend of $0.40 per share payable February 23, 2018, to stockholders of record as of February 12, 2018. 
The Este Lauder Companies (EL) will pay a quarterly dividend of $.38 per share on the Company's Class A and Class B Common Stock on March 15, 2018 to stockholders of record at the close of business on February 28, 2018. 
Rockwell Collins (COL) has declared a quarterly dividend of 33 cents per share on its common stock, payable March 5, 2018, to shareholders of record at the close of business on February 12, 2018. 
CBS Corporation (CBS) has approved a quarterly dividend on the Company's stock of $.18 per share. 
The dividend is payable on April 1, 2018, to shareholders of record on March 9, 2018. You Might Like
